description: The Wuling Rongguang is a series of mini commercial vehicles mainly seen as the five-door, five- to eight-seater microvan produced by SAIC-GM-Wuling. A two-door and four-door pickup variant called the Wuling Rongguang Xiaoka is sold alongside the van with a 2.0 ton to 2.5 ton cargo load capacity. An additional model that further covers the 2.5 ton to 3.5 ton light-to-medium cargo load was added in 2018 called the Wuling Rongguang Xinka.
